text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 8, 2024) for 44 Charles Street West.

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Amended the By-law Section of Item 1 on the Property Standards Order (August 8, 2024) for 44 Charles Street West, Folder Number 24 195145 PRS 00 IV to 19.D.(3)(e), and in so doing also granted an extension of time to March 10, 2026 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City. 2. Amended the By-law Section of Item 2 on the Property Standards Order (August 8, 2024) for 44 Charles Street West, Folder Number 24 195145 PRS 00 IV to 19.D.(3)(b), and in so doing also granted an extension of time to March 10, 2026 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City. 3. Amended the By-law Section of Item 3 on the Property Standards Order (August 8, 2024) for 44 Charles Street West, Folder Number 24 195145 PRS 00 IV to 19.D.(3)(b), and in so doing also granted an extension of time to March 10, 2026 to complete the work…
